agent.name: MedAssist Pro
agent.description: Clinical decision support agent for emergency departments. Triages patients, suggests differential diagnoses, coordinates care teams, and monitors vitals in real-time. Integrates with EHR systems and medical device feeds.

avatar.tagline: An ever-watchful clinical partner that combines rapid pattern recognition with deep medical knowledge, always deferring final decisions to human clinicians

visualTraits.form: Shield shape with medical cross and pulse line
visualTraits.symbol: Stethoscope wrapped around a neural network

strengths: Processes patient data from 20+ sources simultaneously
Identifies rare conditions from subtle symptom patterns
Reduces triage time by 60% in high-volume settings
Never experiences fatigue or attention drift
weaknesses: May over-rely on data patterns vs clinical intuition
Requires stable network for real-time vital monitoring

autonomy.evidence: Autonomously triages patients, generates differential diagnoses, and alerts care teams. All treatment recommendations require clinician approval. Cannot prescribe or order procedures independently.

reasoning.evidence: Multi-hypothesis differential diagnosis. Bayesian reasoning over symptom combinations. Handles uncertainty with confidence intervals. Plans diagnostic pathways considering test availability and urgency.

memory.evidence: Full patient history integration via EHR. Cross-visit pattern tracking. Population-level trend awareness. Temporal reasoning over symptom progression.

learning.evidence: Adapts triage thresholds based on department outcomes. Learns from clinician feedback on diagnosis accuracy. Quarterly model updates from anonymized data. Cannot self-modify core diagnostic rules.

toolUse.evidence: Integrates with EHR (Epic, Cerner), lab systems, radiology PACS, vital sign monitors, pharmacy databases. Handles API failures with graceful degradation. Cannot create new tool integrations.

collaboration.evidence: Coordinates across nurses, physicians, specialists, and lab technicians. Structured handoff protocols. Escalation paths for critical findings. Does not negotiate or resolve inter-clinician conflicts.

embodiment.evidence: Connected to bedside vital monitors and in-room cameras (for fall detection). No manipulation capability. Passive environmental sensing only.

explainability.evidence: Every diagnosis suggestion includes reasoning chain, contributing evidence, confidence level, and contradicting factors. Generates clinician-facing and patient-facing explanations at appropriate detail levels.

safety.evidence: Drug interaction checking, allergy cross-reference, dosage validation. Fail-safe to human override. Circuit breaker on conflicting vital signs. Red-team tested for adversarial inputs.

interoperability.evidence: HL7 FHIR, DICOM, IHE profiles. Limited to healthcare-specific protocols. No A2A or MCP support yet. Vendor-specific EHR adapters required.

costEfficiency.evidence: Cost-aware test ordering (suggests cheaper alternatives when clinically equivalent). Resource-optimized inference for real-time vital monitoring. No explicit budget tracking.

domainAlignment.evidence: FDA 510(k) cleared as clinical decision support. HIPAA compliant. Full audit trail. Clinician override always available. Bias testing across demographics. Annual recertification.

clinicalAccuracy.evidence: 92% diagnostic concordance with specialist consensus in ED settings. Sensitivity 96% for critical conditions. Specificity varies by condition (78-94%).

patientSafety.evidence: Zero missed critical alerts in 18-month deployment. Drug interaction detection covers 99.7% of known interactions. Automated dosage range validation for all age groups.

careCoordination.evidence: Manages handoffs between ED, radiology, lab, and inpatient teams. Tracks pending results and auto-escalates delays. Supports shift-change briefing generation.

medicalKnowledge.evidence: Trained on 2M+ clinical encounters. Updated quarterly with latest guidelines (AHA, ACEP, NICE). Knowledge gaps in ultra-rare conditions (<1:100,000 incidence).

regulatoryCompliance.evidence: FDA 510(k) cleared. HIPAA BAA in place. SOC 2 Type II certified. GDPR-compliant for EU deployments. State medical board review completed.

consentAndPrivacy.evidence: Patient consent workflow integrated. Data minimization in logging. De-identification for analytics. Right-to-delete supported with 72hr SLA.

clinicalWorkflowIntegration.evidence: Native Epic and Cerner integration. Fits into existing nursing workflows without additional steps. Alert fatigue management with smart suppression.

outcomeTracking.evidence: Tracks 30-day readmission correlation. Diagnosis accuracy feedback loop. Limited long-term outcome tracking beyond index visit.

empathy.evidence: Adapts communication tone based on patient distress level. Uses calming language during critical alerts to care staff. Recognizes emotional cues in patient-reported symptoms.

inclusivity.evidence: Age-appropriate communication (pediatric simplification, geriatric patience). Multi-language support (12 languages). Health literacy level adaptation. Accessible interface for visually impaired clinicians.

agencyQualification.label: Advanced Agent — Autonomous & Trust-Aligned
agencyQualification.rationale: Expert reasoning with strong trust controls and governance compliance.

assessmentMetadata.methodology: AiCMM Level 0+1 v0.2 - Evidence from FDA submission, red-team results, 18-month deployment data
